_doc: T032 gov-oracle, L6 temporal. The statutory legacy as at the date of death. scripts/oracle_verify.py runs FixedNetSum.AsAt for each date_of_death and requires the Computed arm to equal expected_money. The two primary cases are the 22 June 2026 L6 spike's dates; the two boundary cases sit either side of SI 2023/758's commencement, so a condition written > instead of >= fails. Figures and commencement dates were read from legislation.gov.uk's machine-readable data on sourced_at. The wrong-as-at negative control is tests/oracles/negative/fixed-net-sum-wrong-as-at.oracle.json; scripts/test-l6-temporal-oracle.sh requires it to go RED.
statute: Administration of Estates Act 1925 s.46(1)(i) Table Case (2)(B) and Schedule 1A; SI 2020/33 (Fixed Net Sum Order 2020); SI 2023/758 (Fixed Net Sum Order 2023)
